recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Leg-B de-commit currently a fixed 5-tick re-elevation block whose magnitude is swamped by natural-commit latch occupancy (visible only on the weak-commit seed 42). (a) scale the de-commit hold with committed-run length (refractory proportional to committed_steps-since-entry) OR convert the de-commit to an active maintenance-release-pressure event (MECH-342 CommitMaintenanceRelease-style) that drives the latch DOWN rather than merely blocking re-entry; (b) redesign C2 to a within-arm around-closure occupancy delta (pre-vs-post-closure window on the ON arm) and tighten the non-vacuity gate to require sd034_n_closure_coupled_elevations > 0 on scored seeds so the closure (not a natural commit) is the elevation source the de-commit acts on.

learning_extracted: Beta-engagement coupling (460e fix) is seed-conditional: it engages the latch on the closure-plane commit only when natural running_variance crossing does NOT also fire (weak-commit seed 42); on strong-commit seeds 43/44 it is inert (sd034_n_closure_coupled_elevations 0/0) and the de-commit DV reduces to the bare Leg-B refractory.

Leg-B de-commit refractory has the correct sign (de-commit lowers occupancy: seed 42 -33.5%, 460e seed 44) but insufficient authority magnitude (fixed 5-tick block, ~20-35 tick-blocks vs ~530-560 natural-commit elevated steps).

C2 between-arm unpaired occupancy DV is underpowered for a few-tick-per-closure effect; a within-arm around-closure pre-vs-post delta would isolate the refractory from cross-arm stochastic variance + natural-commit baseline.

beta_engagement_both_arms readiness gate is necessary but not sufficient as a non-vacuity gate for the de-commit DV: it asserts beta elevates, not that the coupling makes the per-seed DV sensitive to the closure de-commit (require sd034_n_closure_coupled_elevations > 0 on scored seeds).

claim_ids hygiene: a Leg-A-hook-only run (n_automatic_fires=0) does NOT exercise MECH-261 mode-conditioning; it must not weaken the stable MECH-261 (the EXQ-048/MECH-057b inherited-tag failure-mode class).
